tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search SkillU's catalog of curated Agent Skills by keyword, with optional category and tier filters. Returns matching skills with their name, tagline, category, tier and detail-page URL. Use an empty query to list skills (picks are ordered as in the catalog).

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get the full detail of one SkillU Agent Skill by its slug: description, workflow steps, supported agents, tier, version and detail-page URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all skill categories on SkillU with the number of skills in each.
